rules: Every bundled file, package and legacy reference is listed here with source, version/commit, license and SHA-256.
Packages are pinned by exact commit in Package.resolved; assets by SHA-256 of each file (checksums filled at intake, verified by CI).
Changing any pin is a reviewed change: diff of this file + re-run of the tests named in usedBy.
licenseStatus "decision-needed" or "verify…" blocks shipping that asset at its gate, not development.
Nothing here asserts a license that was not stated in the handoff or the review evidence.
Font files are tracked in `fonts` (B1/V01); exportEmbed and publicHosting are false for every font until a licence explicitly allows them.
